name: ip-check
description: Checks a public IP address for risk signals: a 0-100 risk score, network type (residential, hosting, VPN, proxy, Tor, mobile), reasons, and whether it looks suitable for signing in to Claude. Data comes from ip-check.leeguoo.com and public network signals; it cannot prove an account is safe.

settings.title: API key (optional)
settings.description: A free ipck_ key from account.leeguoo.com/apikeys raises the daily lookup limit from 10 to 100. It is sent only to ip-check.leeguoo.com.
